question: The famous ‘Pashupatinath Temple’ is located in which country from the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The famous **'Pashupatinath Temple'** is located in **Nepal**.
 
• Pashupatinath Temple is a sacred Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva and is situated on the banks of the **Bagmati River **in Kathmandu, Nepal.
 
• It is one of the most significant Hindu temples of Lord Shiva in the world and is also a UNESCO World
